A Whimsical Garden Mehendi

A playful garden party, styled for Silhouette Events

Event
Mehendi
Venue
Raffles Udaipur
Location
Udaipur
Date
November 2021
Guests
200+
Styled for
Silhouette Events

A mehendi full of curiosities: vintage sideboards, scalloped pavilions, a turquoise-tiled dining terrace and little discoveries at every corner.

We styled cosy lounges on the lawn with cane armchairs and bright cushions, and filled antique furniture with plants, books and keepsakes for guests to explore.

Bar and food stations were dressed with seasonal produce and wild florals, keeping the mood relaxed and full of colour.

  • Scalloped pavilion lounges
  • Antique sideboard vignettes
  • Tiled dining terrace
  • Bright garden seating
